# Real-world corpus statements that GoSQLX does not yet handle.
# Format: <dialect>/<file>#<statement index> <failing stage>
# Stages: parse, reparse, idempotent, drop (formatter lost words), panic.
# Indexes shift when statements are added to or removed from a file: regenerate then.
# Regenerate: go test ./pkg/gosqlx -run TestRealWorldCorpus -update-known-failures
